propositions: verify.overlap_enabled is undocumented in docs/config.md and only appears in ADR 0037, creating an operator discoverability gap for a feature with per-tracker-size LLM token cost

the field name describes an internal mechanism (overlap detection) rather than the user-visible product (duplicate ticket suggestions), causing it to be misread as a blocking gate under verify section

legacy config key overlap_enabled and env var REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED must remain functional permanently via alias infrastructure that already exists (_ALIASES dict, _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES, warn_deprecated registry)
canonical field rename from verify.overlap_enabled to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets with permanent-not-scheduled classification, keeping live config at rebar.toml:39 working without breakage

config.md must document the advisory nature (never blocks), three-stage algorithm (digest enrichment, BM25F retrieval, LLM judge), cost model (scales with tracker size), and relationship to overlap_* tuning keys
